rules.pattern: Diabetes is a common endocrine-metabolic disorder that disrupts glucose metabolism and causes metabolic and anabolic disturbances
rules.replacement: Diabetes mellitus is a common metabolic-endocrine disorder marked by impaired glucose metabolism and anabolic and metabolic abnormalities

rules.pattern: Diabetes mellitus commonly impairs glucose metabolism and is associated with metabolic and anabolic disturbances
rules.replacement: Diabetes mellitus is a common metabolic-endocrine disorder marked by impaired glucose metabolism and anabolic and metabolic abnormalities

rules.pattern: Type 1 diabetes \(insulin-dependent\) and Type 2 diabetes \(non-insulin-dependent\) are distinguished; the latter needs long-term care because hyperglycemia, ketosis, cardiovascular and renal disease, severe infections, and death may occur
rules.replacement: This disease is mainly split into Type 1 (insulin-dependent) and Type 2 (non-insulin-dependent) forms. Type 2 diabetes requires ongoing care; complications may include hyperglycemia, ketosis, hyperosmolar shock, coma, cardiovascular disease, arteriosclerosis, ocular, renal, and neurological disease, severe infections, and death

rules.pattern: Group 7 had a 2-week run-in, streptozotocin diabetes induction, then glibenclamide for 6 weeks
rules.replacement: Group 7 followed the same 2-week run-in and STZ diabetes protocol, then received glibenclamide for 6 weeks

rules.pattern: Glucose, insulin, and body weight were checked before diabetes induction, at 2-3 days post-STZ, after 2 weeks on treatment, and at 6 weeks
rules.replacement: We measured blood glucose, insulin, and body weight before diabetes induction, at 2-3 days post-STZ, after 2 weeks of treatment, and at 6 weeks

rules.pattern: Diabetic rats given nettle, fenugreek, or both showed lower glucose and body weight and higher insulin
rules.replacement: In diabetic rats, nettle and fenugreek extracts lowered blood glucose and body weight; insulin levels rose, alone or in combination

rules.pattern: Effects matched those seen with the diabetes drug glibenclamide
rules.replacement: The response was broadly similar to glibenclamide, a standard diabetes drug

rules.pattern: Clinical work in patients is required to verify dose and benefit
rules.replacement: Clinical studies in patients are still needed to confirm these findings and set an appropriate dose

rules.pattern: Treated rats had lower glucose and body weight and higher insulin
